contract.convergence: Any ConvergenceWarning blocks completion; never adapt C, iterations or labels
contract.feature_policy: Only target calendar fields; no weather, season, holiday, workingday, raw IDs/date/year, targets/components, lags or interactions
contract.final_test: IDs/times metadata only; no labels, balance, fitting, predictions or scoring until later approved gate
contract.fit_cadence: Once at first development issuance; frozen through validation
contract.metric_clipping: sklearn 1.7.2 clips each probability to [float64 eps,1-eps], no post-clipping renormalization; preserve raw scores
contract.objective: mean binary cross entropy + sum(w**2)/(2*C*n_train); intercept unpenalized; no sample/class weights

policies.selection: Two fixed demonstrations, no winner or cost tuning

contract.primary_metric: Mean binary log_loss, natural log, labels=[0,1], float64 probabilities; no penalty in evaluation
contract.prior_access: Inherited whole-source mechanical schema/domain/component checks read all count fields; final targets are not literally unseen
contract.readiness_qualification: Hypothetical immediate aggregate availability; train target t allowed only if t+1h <= first validation issuance. Not an operational source guarantee.
contract.representation_caveat: Reference coding breaks category symmetry for penalized models; unknown category uses zero reference block
contract.selection_basis: Inherited #21 windows and ordered-ID hashes; no score-driven selection
contract.time_semantics: Naive source-calendar interval-start labels by convention, not verified UTC/timezone/DST or elapsed-hour semantics
contract.windows: Half-open target-label windows; training is 2011 calendar year before readiness exclusion
